evidence.quote: We used the AllenNLP library (Gardner et al., 2017) with the HuggingFace transformers library (Wolf et al., 2019) PyTorch implementation of T5-small with 16-bit ﬂoating point precision.
The best abstraction aware model achieved an overall accuracy of 88.8% compared to the baseline model achieving 62.3% on CLUTRR.
However, for HotpotQA and CoQA, we ﬁnd that F1 scores improve by only 0.5% on average.
Unfortunately, results on these more natural language datasets show that abstraction aware models are not signiﬁcantly better than baseline models.
